verdict.rationale: Docusign documents an official MCP server on its developer site. It describes a supported Claude connector via that server and pairs Gemini CLI with Docusign MCP, exposing tools to retrieve agreement context, query status and key dates, and trigger IAM workflow actions. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working, and documented setup/auth details and a full tool list in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Docusign Connector in Anthropic Claude via MCP server provides a supported way to connect Claude to Docusign IAM capabilities.
Query agreement data and automate agreement processes from your terminal by pairing Gemini CLI with Docusign MCP.
Retrieve agreement context and metadata... Query agreement status and key dates... Trigger workflow actions through IAM tools
